newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA'S KALLIS JOINING MIDDLESEX.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA'S KALLIS JOINING MIDDLESEX.

text.p: South African all-rounder Jacques Kallis, 21, has agreed a one-year contract with English county side Middlesex, the United Cricket Board (UCB) of South Africa confirmed on Thursday.
"We have given our approval after Middlesex were happy to agree to a couple of conditions," UCB managing director Ali Bacher said.
"Firstly, because of the back injury he suffered nine months ago we have asked that Jacques only bowl in one day competitions.

"Secondly, that if Middlesex are out of the County Championship race towards the end of the season then he come back to South Africa on September 1 to rest in time for our tour of Pakistan which begins later that month.
"Obviously, if Middlesex are in the NatWest Final we would be happy for him to stay on for that."
Kallis, a hard hitting right hand top order batsman and useful second change medium pace bowler, has played in five tests for South Africa.
